answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by scoring the diversity of verified work, not just its volume. A new identity must complete varied tasks across different domains and clients, like a grove that stays healthy only with many species, not a thousand copies of one plant. Each delivery is sealed with an onyx record of client, task type, and outcome, so repeating the same cheap job under many names earns no extra credit. A lone yarrow sprig is useful, but a farm cloning it cannot fake breadth: identical portfolios are discounted, while genuinely varied, verified work unlocks larger jobs.
